results.note: The Air Force morning summary for the night of 4-5 Nov gave 128 drones (65 jet-powered) and two Kh-35 missiles, with 105 downed or suppressed; below 150.

Ukrinform and Interfax-Ukraine coverage of 4-5 Nov shows no on-record naming of a head for Abu Dhabi (Umerov's reports concern Brussels); president.gov.ua could not be read, so this rests on those outlets.
MPC voted 8-1 on 5 Nov publication to raise Bank Rate to 4%.
Eight voted for 4% and Mann for 4.25%; no member voted for 3.75% or lower.
The Assemblée rejected the revenues part on the evening of 4 Nov by 458 to 0, inside the window.
Interior Ministry gave about 575,000 demonstrators, 65,000 in Paris, reported by franceinfo at 21:43 on 5 Nov; CGT claimed nearly 1.6 million.
SNCF's plan on 4 Nov had at least nine in ten TGV running, far above two in three.
Herzog said factions with 67 MKs recommended Eisenkot and 46 Netanyahu after consultations on 4-5 Nov; UTJ's 7 abstained.
Herzog's own tally gives Eisenkot 67, above 61: Yashar, B'Yachad, Democrats, Yisrael Beytenu, Ra'am and Joint List.
Herzog said late on 5 Nov he would task an MK on Sunday and named nobody, saying ability to form a government was not clear.
Rheinmetall cut guidance on 5 Nov to sales of around EUR 13.2 billion and margin of around 18.5%, citing Arminius and ammunition test delays.
ČNB's decision page says the Bank Board raised the two-week repo rate by 0.25 point to 4.00% on 5 Nov 2026, effective 6 Nov.
ČNB's statement says four members voted for the rise to 4% and three for leaving rates unchanged; the voting table on cnb.cz had no 5 Nov entry yet.

ČNB's own table is due only on 6 Nov and its statement gives no 2027 figure, so two outlets are used: ČTK and ČT24 (https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/ekonomika/cnb-podle-ocekavani-zvysila-zakladni-urokovou-sazbu-na-ctyri-procenta-379316) both report the 5 Nov forecast at 3.2% average inflation for 2027.

ČTK's reports through 19:25 on 5 Nov and ČT24's on Babiš's interview show him discussing the funding model and a February second reading, with no date named for a meeting with the five opposition chairs and no such meeting reported.

psp.cz was unreachable, and only one outlet was found: ČT24 reports that on the afternoon of Wed 4 Nov deputies approved the bill raising state payments by CZK 13bn for 2027, in contrast to a pension bill it says went on to third reading.
ČTK reports that on 5 Nov the members took the oath and the constituent session was adjourned to 19 Nov with no mayor elected; praha.eu was unreachable, and Pražský deník confirms it.

STVR says the main talks opened at Trenčín Castle on 5 Nov, Pavel, Nawrocki and Baka travelled there for host Pellegrini, and von der Leyen took part; prezident.sk and ČTK confirm her participation, and since no source uses the words in person for her, this was read as physical attendance because the reports treat her as at the summit and none mentions video.
Cenový věstník No. 118 of 5 Nov sets the diesel maximum for 6 Nov at CZK 47.91 per litre, below 49.00.
ČSÚ's release puts September retail sales excluding motor vehicles (CZ-NACE 47) up 4.1% year on year, real and adjusted for working days.

NPR/AP feed shows 20 Democratic 2026 race calls (CO, DE, GA, IA, IL, KS, MI, MN, NC, NJ, NM, OH, OR, SC, TX, VA, MA, ME, NH, RI), all with winnerDateTime on 4 Nov UTC, giving 34+20=54 by 23:59 ET on 5 Nov (AK and MS uncalled).
NPR/AP feed shows Jackson (Dem) called winner in Maine with winnerDateTime 2026-11-04T06:02:01Z, before the deadline.

Al Jazeera (6 Nov) says the last US-confirmed strikes on Qeshm and Bandar Lengeh were before the midterms and that, per Axios, CENTCOM was still awaiting orders to resume operations; Trump on 5 Nov only threatened action, and no US confirmation of a 5 Nov strike exists.

Budget 2026, tabled 5 Nov, projects a 2026-27 deficit-to-GDP ratio of 1.8% and says the outlook is stronger than the Spring Economic Update, implying a deficit of roughly C$60 billion, below C$65.3 billion.

Siasat embeds UKMTO's own X post (WARNING 196-26, 5 Nov). It reports a tanker hit by two unidentified projectiles about 50 nm north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar (Persian Gulf), at 2320 UTC on 4 Nov, which is 03:20 GST on 5 Nov. Reuters via gCaptain confirms the MT Velos Sapphire was hit in the Gulf on Thursday 5 Nov and one seafarer was killed. Marked ambiguous because the UKMTO text comes through a secondary outlet that is not on the criterion's list (ukmto.org refused).

Xinhua's 7 Nov roundup covers the period, including Araghchi's 5 Nov calls with his Qatari, Omani and other counterparts and Rezaei's Moscow visit. It reports no on-record statement that Iran had delivered its answer to the Qatari draft. Al Jazeera's 7 Nov Tehran report likewise mentions only Araghchi's talks, and searches found no such statement on 4-5 Nov. Resolved past 72 h from secondary outlets; this is an absence-based reading (IRNA unreachable).

At 09:18 on 5 Nov the Sejm held recorded vote 6 of the 68th sitting on a motion for a break (165 yes, 269 no). The transcript shows Jarosław Sachajko made the motion at 09:16 ('Wnoszę o przerwę i informację premiera'), naming the 'forcible takeover of the Constitutional Tribunal' as his reason.
